item.title: Fallen of the Idols
item.description:
We are living over shouting wolves, already under my skin. I am hopeless, I want to be the solution. Give me a hopeless meaning. How we lose? Under the graveyard, I am already to be forgiven. I want to be an open letter, falling over the hopes. I wanted to stay alive, being here and there.
Being ashamed. Being hopeless. Watch me carefully, shouting so naive. Over these guns I am already been there. Hopeless revolver. My shogun is dying. He misses so much his idols. I cannot see how this story will ends. Showing, shoved meanings over this question. I am Shogun, the realm being shaped. Look at us, look at back then.. Over the refused action, the Shogun is dying.

item.title: Samurai Babel #6 A Lion
item.description: They care about you. Listen to them always, they are right. Putting letters at them are being safe. I wish, I wish to stay with mine kid, I am fighting my demons. You are a lion, I see a lion like I saw and look at me. I am the lion. You are the lion. Inside my head. Inside my home I am the lion because I am the will. I won’t leave them to remember dreams. WE know to see the tomorrow. If you see a lion, You will see family. Even when you are sleeping, they are watching to see you breathing. I won’t give it up, I am a lion. Forget, for I forgot who I was. I am a lion. I have been taught well. Sharing creed, I want to say to you. Do you see a lion watching when I am dreaming? All I wanted is to feel safety, to feel safe. In bad habits, I am dreaming. I am a lion. Look at me? I am a lion.

item.title: Samurai Babel #5 Welcome Home
item.description: No one say, how I must live. I am a champion. Crushing my names. It’s another grenade. Can you kill me? You are trying to break me. I am already dead. No more issues, here I am with a knife to end this past. Am I dreaming? I am getting all the time excuses to die. No one hates me, I am trying to kill me. I am already dead, I won’t shape me because I am dead. Shishimoto, I am right here.

item.title: Samurai Babel #4 Smile
item.description: • Dear Shishimoto, how are you? How have you been? This is a new snake song being sung over the lake. A different call. A different summon of my cull. I missed you a lot. Trying to break cycles. I can shape you even if you break me. I am already dead acting like a Ronin. I am edging over our own lies. I am trying to deny the assumptions. Hopeless. You are a lake trying to embrace me. I am yours. An eternal unconditional love. You are the hero of my story. Trying to embrace life. Our own lives are a lake near a shore. Embrace your life. You have now a son. Don’t shout at me, I am right here, trying to embrace the engulfing desert,

item.title: Samurai Babel #2 War Beneath
item.description: I felt shame for being mad, and a little of a lunatic. Sister forgive me. I am here for you all. Allusive. These walls are closing out. Do you feel hungry? Do you keep it near? No more allusive mirrors. It’s God’s fault. Lost cause coming back. Mind wars. An open, open wide-open eyes, lost soul not coming back. I know, you heard it all. No more walking shadows on my society’s illness. Lost cause coming back. Bushido law is coming back, sister, my beloved sister.

item.title: Samurai Babel #1 Introduction
item.description:
The world of Babel takes on the lands of Shishiwara, lands of forbidden wars, a land of loss and confusion. Where the lies become the sins of the persons. Turned into several Shogun Tribes and cabals. Of fear and fearless lands.

We dig into them as lost souls, keepers or saviors of their own skins.

Today, those lands are even through a piece to achieve every day, with no struggles. The wars led us to a dark moment lost in our minds. A dark moment for don’t be forgiven or lead to us a war again.
